name: Wandering Sprout
summary: Where there is already wood, the sprout nourishes; and peeks at the trail ahead.

face.name: Wandering Sprout

nourish.text: If you control another Auros Entity, you gain 2 HP.

peek.text: Look at the top card of your deck: you may put it on the bottom of your deck.

face.flavor: Small, but it already knows where to go.
